transitions.condition: SensorWeight AND weightComplete AND weight is outside the inclusive range

timer_plan.note: No timing requirement is specified. Do not introduce rejection pulses, travel timeouts, or reversal delays without an approved specification.

priorities: Manual mode overrides the automatic route: set phase to WAIT_FEED, clear kick and CompletionLight, and retain firingTemp. Manual forward and reverse requests are mutually exclusive; simultaneous requests inhibit both.

Automatic mode permits forward motion only. Evaluate at most one phase transition per invocation, using the pre-transition phase. Destination arrival stops motion in the same invocation; a completion already asserted on arrival is not accepted until a later invocation.
Accept completion levels only in their corresponding wait state and only while the matching station sensor is true. Ignore unrelated confirmations.
An out-of-range item enters REJECT immediately, remains stopped with kick asserted while SensorWeight is true, and cannot proceed to firing.

Mode entry uses the reset WAIT_FEED phase; SensorFeed may start the route on that invocation. A reset or transition to WAIT_FEED from another phase does not also start a new route in the same invocation.

The design assumes one product and noncontradictory station sensors. Motor interlocking in application logic is not a substitute for an independently engineered safety circuit and contactor interlocks.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.details: Sample all inputs once; update previousMode and mode-edge indications unconditionally. Completion and sensor conditions are sampled levels, not required edges.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.details: Apply the manual reset priority or evaluate one automatic transition from the applicable pre-transition phase. Latch the setpoint only on a qualified WAIT_WEIGHT judgment. Use binary32 rounding at each indicated arithmetic operation; otherwise retain the previous setpoint.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.details: There are no timer FBs in this design, so this stage has zero calls. Any subsequently approved timer FB must be called once per scan here, outside CASE/IF.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.details: Assign outputs once from the sampled inputs and post-transition phase. In manual: MotorForward = ForwardButton AND NOT ReverseButton; MotorReverse = ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton; kick and CompletionLight are false. In automatic: MotorForward is true exactly in the four MOVE states; MotorReverse is false; kick is true exactly in REJECT; CompletionLight is true exactly in OUTPUT_DONE. Assign firingTemp from the retained setpoint. Thus transitions affect outputs in the same invocation.
